notes.title: Zombie Vikings launches today!
notes.content:
Today, at 8 am PST / 4 pm GMT, Zombie Vikings will be alive and kicking on Steam. We have put a lot of work into this version, and we really hope you will have a great time with it. Oh, and if you buy the game during the first week, you can look forward to a launch discount!

The Steam version of the game includes a lot of new features. How about this? 

Unicorn Pig – In single-player mode, you’re now joined by a Unicorn Pig that’ll team up with you throughout the adventure.
New Enemies – Lots of completely new enemies added
Progression – Unlock weapons as you progress through levels.
Weapon Improvements – All weapons now have special effects and their stats are displayed in the store.
Combat improvements – Direct roll, Mini health-bars, target hints etc.
Plus more updates!

Will you play right away? Let us know what you think in the Steam forums!

Cheers!
Alexandra Dahlberg
Community Manager, Zoink Games

notes.title: Zombie Vikings coming in December
notes.content:
The Steam version of Zombie Vikings will launch in December and will include a major update to the game! We’ve listened to feedback from our community and have used this to change the game for the better. Among many things the single-player experience is changed, we’ve added a snuggly Unicorn Pig called Oink that’ll join you in your adventure. All good games should have a Unicorn Pig.

Zombie Vikings Major Update includes:

Unicorn Pig - In single-player mode, you’re now joined by a Unicorn Pig that’ll team up with you throughout the adventure.
New Enemies - Lots of completely new enemies added
Progression - Unlock weapons as you progress through levels
Weapon Improvements - All weapons now have special effects and their stats are displayed in the store
Combat improvements - Direct roll, Mini health-bars, target hints etc. 
Plus more updates!
The Steam Version will include these features on launch day. Other platforms will get this update for free as well. We’ll post more info about this shortly. 

So, what do you think? Let us know in the Steam forums! :)

Take care!

Mikael Forslind
Marketing Dude, Zoink Games
